scope: Proposition 2.5 (Three-point flatness) of the manuscript “Uniform Interior $`C^{1,\alpha}`$ Estimates for Infinity-Harmonic Functions” (preprints/Uniform-Interior-C1alpha-Estimates-for-Infinity-Harmonic-Functions-October-4-2026/interior-c1-infinity-harmonic.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 377 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 8c01e0c934ce3ef1), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 7. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let Ui be infinity-harmonic on B1 ⊂ Rn with a common Lipschitz bound, and let ℓi be affine functions such that ∥Ui − ℓi∥L∞(B1) −→ 0. Then sup x,y∈B1/4 x̸=y |Ui(x) + Ui(y) − 2Ui((x + y)/2)| |x − y| −→ 0. (2.1)
